newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: 11 die, 24 injured in Guatemala bus blaze.
newsitem.headline: 11 die, 24 injured in Guatemala bus blaze.

text.p: Eleven people were burnt to death on Monday and 24 others were injured when a passenger bus exploded in Guatemala City, fire officials said.
"There was an explosion," said volunteer Fire Department spokesman Julio Mariscal, adding that the blast was caused by cannisters of paint thinner that were accidentally ignited by a cigarette.
Mariscal said that according to survivors, two men smoking cigarettes boarded the bus carrying canisters of paint thinner, and they apparently caused the explosion.
Radio reports said the back door of the bus failed to open and that burning passengers were trapped inside. The fire was later extinguished and the survivors pulled out, Mariscal said.
